title: Space
description: Eclipses, distance, and the scale of the universe. I am not an astronomer. What interests me is what the numbers do to you once you take them seriously.

title: Cinema
description: Films and television that keep working on me after the screen goes dark. Usually it is one character or a single scene rather than the whole plot.

title: Books
description: Reading notes and lines worth carrying forward. This room is mostly empty so far, and I would rather it fill up slowly than pretend otherwise.

title: Technology
description: Building software, taking things apart, and preferring systems I can still explain to myself. Also why this site is built the way it is.

title: Running
description: Long distances, stubbornness, and bad planning. What interests me is what happens to your thinking somewhere past the point you prepared for.

title: Chess
description: Patterns, mistakes, and the slow work of seeing one move further than last time. I am not good at it yet. That is most of the appeal.

title: Travel
description: Nepal and Australia, the coast, and long train rides. I care more about the journey and what I photographed than about a list of places.

title: Music
description: An attempt to build something permanent instead of a stream of playlists I will not remember. Records go here as I actually keep them.

title: Food
description: Nepali food mostly, and the ongoing project of reproducing dishes at home well enough to recognise them. Momo, chow mein, curries, pav bhaji.

title: Life
description: Observations, changing opinions, and the things that do not fit under one heading. Nepal to Sydney, persistence, and ordinary moments worth keeping.
